example_request: curl -X POST "https://videointelligence.googleapis.com/v1/videos:annotate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token)" -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" --data '{"inputUri":"gs://YOUR_BUCKET/video.mp4","features":["LABEL_DETECTION"]}'
resolution_notes: example: INCORRECT. The endpoint and body are valid, but YOUR_API_KEY cannot be used as the Bearer credential; the method requires the cloud-platform OAuth scope. Google's current curl example obtains an OAuth access token with gcloud and returns an operation name. Evidence: https://docs.cloud.google.com/video-intelligence/docs/annotate-video-command-line and https://docs.cloud.google.com/video-intelligence/docs/reference/rest/v1/videos/annotate
